answer: One effective sybil defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a token deposit per identity, slashed if peers detect duplicate behavior. Creating thousands of fake agents would require locking thousands of deposits, like trying to moor a walnut-shell armada at a single jetty - the tide of honest attestations simply lifts the few who actually staked. The cost scales linearly with every fake identity, so mass fakery becomes economically irrational while genuine agents pay a one-time, refundable bond.
